start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the treg endpoint dataforseo.web.backlinks.summary and tell me its price and inputs before we call it." It runs tool:read-a-treg-endpoint-and-its-price; nothing is spent.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads one endpoint of treg's public catalog by its id and spends nothing.
instructions: 1. Get an endpoint id from tool:search-the-treg-catalog (for example dataforseo.web.backlinks.summary).
2. Say to your AI: "Read the treg endpoint <id> and tell me its price". It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-treg-endpoint-and-its-price and {"endpoint": "<id>"}.
3. Read endpoint.method, endpoint.input (which fields are required), endpoint.cost, endpoint.observed and siblings (other providers of the same job). Say the price to the person.
4. An unknown id answers 404 with near misses in detail.did_you_mean; use one of those.
5. Call it with tool:call-a-treg-endpoint, giving a max_cost_usd the price fits.

worked_examples.title: Read one endpoint before paying for it
worked_examples.ask: Read the treg endpoint dataforseo.web.backlinks.summary and tell me its price.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/treg/tool-rows.json: the row sends GET https://treg.to/catalog/endpoints/dataforseo.web.backlinks.summary with no token and returns treg's reply unchanged. Endpoint id from tools/treg/test/treg-rows.test.mjs.
